human_sources.title: Actions of discrete amenable groups on injective factors of type III-lambda, lambda not one
human_sources.role: The return-arrow reduction and the vertical comparison formula are the classical construction of Sutherland–Takesaki [ST89], Section 1.3 and the proof of Theorem 4.2 (pp.430–431). The return invariant and its semifinite classification use [ST], Theorem 1.2 and Section 4. This lesson retains every isotropy label, writes the composition and range-unitary identities explicitly, and integrates both the standard-form map and its inverse. The scalar and positive gauges use the preceding programme comparison theorem.
